about: A coding sheet for the topic focus rating of each core-grant Member Association's business plan. One row per organisation, a plan page for every rating, never free text in place of a rating. The strongest objection (map skill spec, section 4): this is a human reading every year, so a change from last year needs a second reader.

rules.why: every rating cites the plan page it rests on

rules.text: second_reader is required for any rating that changed from last year; the refresh mode compares years and enforces it (phase c).
